Fixed by #3061's commit a821c334; this task's commit f3a6a228 adds the guard rows (Pl/t/parser2-01.t, the F6 rows; fail on aff112d7) and the board-row edits.
Bars: IO-Compress t/cz-03zlib-v1.t now runs 400 of 472 (395 pass, 5 NS at-FILE-line); its two #3347 rows left cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit; the 72 missing loop rows are #3619 (filed).  Gate PASS 324 files / 11,090 rows on the rebased tree 055ebe2e (MAIN-READY-37 + the batch).
